description.en: Artistic canvas and shader loading indicators designed for creative web apps.
description.zh: 艺术质感的 Canvas 动态加载器与水彩光影反馈控件，适合创意设计网站。

content.en: Painterly brings painterly, fluid canvas and shader loading indicators to modern React web projects. Moving beyond conventional spinning circles, Painterly renders soft brushstrokes, generative fluid bleeds, and organic visual feedback.
content.zh: Painterly 是一组跳脱出传统几何旋转 Loader 的艺术级 Canvas / WebGL 动态加载指示器。它运用柔和的水彩笔触晕染、生成式流体扩散与动态光影，让页面等待过程化身为富有美学观赏性的视觉体验。
